title: The AI Search Ranking Checklist
description:
Ranking #1 in AI search is going to require more than content.

Make your business easy for agents to discover and use: clean markdown files, MCP access, pricing, use cases, technical docs, and agent-friendly payments.

The easier you are for agents to access, evaluate, and recommend, the better your chances of showing up.
